senses.gloss: † गह् गह्, i. 10, गहय, Par. To strive, to penetrate.

गाह् गाह् (akin to गभ् in गभीर and गाध् in गाध), i. 1, Ātm. (in epic poetry also Par., MBh. 13, 3795). With acc. and loc.
 1. To dive into, Rām. 3, 76, 33.
 2. To enter, Rām. 2, 52, 95.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass.
 I. गाहित, with the sense of the act., MBh. 3, 8772.
 II. गाढ,
 1. Used for bathing in, Ragh. 9, 72.
 2. Accessible, open, Bhāg. P. 4, 29, 40.
 3. Fast, tight, Rām. 4, 15, 20.
 4. Vehement, Amar. 36; Megh. 81. ढम्, adv.
 1. Strongly, fast, Mārk. P. 16, 25; Rām. 2, 31, 2.
 2. Vehemently, Rām. 1, 9, 47.
 3. Heavily, Chr. 35, 7.
 4. Much, Rām. 2, 57, 3.
 --Comp.
 --With the prep. अव अव (sometimes व without its initial),
 1. To dive into, Rām. 1, 2, 8.
 2. To bathe, MBh. 3, 8649.
 3. To betake one's self, Vikr. 62, 15. अवगाहित and अवगाढ, Used for bathing in, MBh. 3, 8230; 8236. अवगाढ,
 1. Immersed, Rām. 2, 59, 28.
 2. Deeply [] impressed, Śāk. d. 56.
 3. Vanished, MBh. 4, 2238.
 4. Stagnating, Suśr. 1, 353, 3.
 --Caus.
 1. To let bathe, Suśr. 2, 192, 11.
 2. To bathe, Suśr. 2, 550, 11.
 --With व्यव वि-अव,
 1. To dive, MBh. 1, 7285.
 2. To break in, MBh. 4, 1984.
 3. To sink down, to begin (as nightfall), MBh. 3, 16820.
 --With उद् उद् in उद्गाढ, Excessive, Prab. 67, 9.
 --With उप उप, To break in, Rām. 6, 31, 29.
 --With संप्र सम्-प्र, To dive into, MBh. 14, 1392.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To dive into, Rām. 2, 48, 8.
 2. To enter, Ragh. 14, 30.
 3. To betake one's self to, MBh. 3, 11343.
 4. To fall (as night; see वि-अव), MBh. 5, 7246. विगाढ,
 1. Bathed, Rām. 5, 7, 39.
 2. Used for bathing, Rām. 5, 74, 31.
 3. Having penetrated, MBh. 4, 2072.
 4. Fallen (as night; see वि-अव), MBh. 3, 1821.
 5. Having taken place, MBh. 5, 2776.
 6. Much, exceeding.
 --Comp. ptcple. of the fut. pass., दुर्विगाह्य, i. e. दुस्-, adj.
 1. Difficult to be sounded, MBh. 13, 1840.
 2. Difficult to be passed, Hariv. 13670.
 3. Difficult to be accomplished, Rām. 5, 51, 23.
 --With प्रवि प्र-वि, To enter, Rām. 6, 16, 2.
 --Cf. βαθύς, βῆσσα for βηθ-ια, βένθος.

गहन गहन, i. e. गभ् (cf. गभी-र, and गाह्) + अन,
 I. adj., f. ना.
 1. Deep, Bhartṛ. 3, 11.
 2. Impervious, Rām. 2, 85, 4.
 3. Impenetrable, Pañc. i. d. 317.
 II. n.
 1. A thicket, Rām. 4, 48, 2.
 2. Impenetrability, obscurity, MBh. 11, 125.
 3. Multitude, Rām. 1, 35, 16.
गाहन गाह् + अन, n. Bathing, Daśak. 145, 14.
गहनत्व गहन + त्व, n. Impenetrability, MBh. 2, 2355.
गहनवन्त् गहन + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, Full of thickets, Rām. 4, 48, 6.

गह्वर गह् + वर (cf. गहन),
 I. adj., f. रा and री, Impenetrable, Bhāg. P. 5, 14, 4.
 II. n.
 1. A thicket, MBh. 4, 727.
 2. An enigma, MBh. 13, 1388.
गह्वरित गह्वरित, i. e. गह्वर + इत, adj. Lying in one's hiding-place, MBh. 2, 2294.
